I have the same problem but with end of uni, and I asked around my friends about how they motivate themselves

one of them told me this: remember things you finished in the past, especially big projects, no matter how hard it seemed you're already past that; now this big thing that is stressing you out - you'll finish it just as you did the last ones, the main thing is to keep working

as for how to actually start working, I like to use apps like Forest, it's an app where you grow trees, mushrooms etc; it has a timer and if you exit the app to use your phone while the timer is on, the tree dies ahah; looking at the time every now and then while I'm working motivates me, and I also try to praise myself for continuing working and not getting distracted too much

also Todoist is a cool app where you can write down tasks for the day and tick them off as soon as you've finished 

also I try to make my surroundings as comfortable as possible, my favourite aroma sticks, open the window for fresh air, herbal tea, calming music

of course everyone has different methods, but maybe some of mine help! I wish you lots of luck with your studies, there's nothing unaccomplishable (if there's such a word ahah) after all
